Emmanuel Manjarrez, left, a signal operations support specialist assigned to 2nd Battalion, 35th Infantry Regiment, 25th Infantry Division, verifies the correct programming in the radio during a radio check as part of Exercise Balikatan 2026 at La Paz Sand Dunes, Laoag City, Philippines, April 22, 2026. Prior to the Counter Landing Live-Fire Exercise, the U.S. Army and Armed Forces of the Philippines signal teams conducted communication checks to ensure all parties can communicate reliably.

U.S. Army Sgt. Jeffrey Pellend, a signal operations support specialist assigned to 2nd Battalion, 35th Infantry Regiment, 25th Infantry Division, conducts a radio check using a keypad display unit as part of Exercise Balikatan 2026 at La Paz Sand Dunes, Laoag City, Philippines, April 22, 2026. Prior to the Counter Landing Live-Fire Exercise, the U.S. Army and Armed Forces of the Philippines signal teams conducted communication checks to ensure all parties can communicate reliably.

U.S. Army Sgt. Dallas Betten, a signal operations support specialist assigned to 2nd Battalion, 35th Infantry Regiment, 25th Infantry Division, demonstrates how the tactical voice bridge functions during a radio check as part of Exercise Balikatan 2026 at La Paz Sand Dunes, Laoag City, Philippines, April 22, 2026. Prior to the Counter Landing Live-Fire Exercise, the U.S. Army and Armed Forces of the Philippines signal teams conducted communication checks to ensure all parties can communicate reliably.

U.S. Soldiers assigned to 2nd Battalion, 35th Infantry Regiment, 25th Infantry Division and the Armed Forces of the Philippines analyze mission plans as part of Exercise Balikatan 2026 at La Paz Sand Dunes, Laoag City, Philippines, April 22, 2026. Prior to the Counter Landing Live-Fire Exercise, the U.S. Army and AFP signal teams conducted communication checks to ensure all parties can communicate reliably.
